$comment: Site defaults: every key, at the built-in value (the links are placeholders). Copy the keys you want to change into the config.json next to the app; leave the rest out so later built-in changes still reach you. Shown on public pages: never put a secret here. See docs/site-defaults.md.

header.$comment: Trace's heading, standalone only. prefix shows before the product name; brand paints both in the shell's brand colour. The links open from the help menu of every tool (http or https only; built in: the build's VITE_BUG_REPORT_URL and VITE_DOCS_URL, else this project's issues and docs).

plot.$comment: The plot behaviour of all three tools; a tool's own plot section overrides it. wheel: x (the wheel zooms X only, Alt+wheel X and every Y) or xy (X and every Y, Alt+wheel the primary Y). yAxisDrag: pan or stretch (Shift or Alt does the other). doubleClick: reset (every axis of the plot) or none (a double-click on an axis still resets that axis). tooltip: cursor or docked (in Trace, whether a new plot's Dock data tooltip is on). The values here are Correlation's and Waveform's built-ins; Trace's are in trace.plot.

What a new Trace plot opens with: Add plot, a fresh tab, and a link or host query that names PVs or a range but carries no plot settings. Also takes the plot-behaviour keys; Trace's own built-in values for them are below. timeRange is a relative range (-1h, -30m). archiver is the plot's default archiver; null means Canopy's default, and a name that does not exist leaves every new plot without archive data. palette is a palette id; a user's own palette pick wins.

trace.$comment: What a new Trace curve opens with. lineType: step or direct (formulas stay direct and take the width and symbols only).

correlation.$comment: What a fresh Correlation view opens with (no state beyond its PVs). lookback: 1m to 24h. dt: the Timer period in seconds, at least 0.1. metrics: the statistics columns, in order, as the link's m= tokens (a leading - lists a metric but leaves it out of the table).

waveform.$comment: What a fresh Waveform view opens with (no state beyond its PVs). rollS: the Rolling mean window, 1 to 3600 s. metrics as in Correlation.
